title: A CODE pointer now accepts scheme-less urls and prose such as and/or#x, untested
goal: kbfacts.code_pointer rejects a first segment that is a dotted host name or a prose pair such as and/or, while an extensionless script path such as src/adr-new still passes; tests plant both; found in the review of SP-eqmblr7t (BG-6l57la6y)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;p=kbfacts.tags_in('- x [CODE S1: and/or#x]');sys.exit(1 if p and kbfacts.code_pointer(p[0]) else 0)
